edition.name: compact
edition.note: Compact edition: all 109,401 HYG stars plus 8,000 brightness-selected Gaia observations (4,000 nearby and 4,000 LMC). The full million-star Gaia field is omitted. Moon maps are 512x256; black-hole optical tables and background/disk charts use lower resolution. Other scenes, named destinations and controls are retained.
